main_body: Round leafy canopy on a short brown trunk, standing on a small grass patch
top_band: Canopy top at x=16: rows 1-4 are lighter greens (L~81-111) under a dark outline at row 0. This is a domed leaf mass, not a flat slab. Below it come the mottled canopy face and the trunk (rows 31+).
evidence: This is an organic tree. The canopy is a rounded volume with lighter leaf clumps on its upper part and darker clumps and shadow underneath. The trunk and grass ellipse sit below it, so it reads as a 3/4 plant rather than a flat elevation or a plan. The canopy has no rectangular top band, but that is normal for foliage, and the dark underside shadow works as the eave shadow. Accepted as a tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours and a median of 6 colours per tile. The references have 427 and 567 distinct colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The canopy uses about 5 green steps with dark-green tinted outlines (0% neutral edge pixels) and has no 5x5 flat fills. Even so, the leaf clumps are blocky and repeat the same few greens. Next to the references, which show per-leaf highlights and multi-hue foliage, it looks much thinner and simpler. The trunk is a flat two-tone strip and the grass patch is almost flat.
